title: Write to the user in one or two short sentences
need: Keep each message to one or two short, literal sentences unless the user asks for more. Describe every number or ID, explain an unfamiliar name once, and ask one decision at a time with a recommendation. Required instructions and recipes stay complete.
surface: AGENTS.md managed block (Writing to users); outside a project, the yoke-global skill and global orientation, all rendered from yoke_contracts.user_writing_rules
gap: Outside a project the rules reach a session only once machine-wide hooks deliver global orientation; see gap onboard-global-entry.
